_instructions: Jarvis runs fully offline: speech recognition uses the local Vosk model, replies come from scripts built into the code, and tts_engine 'sapi' speaks with the built-in Windows voice. Set offline_only true to never touch online services (blocks Google STT and Edge TTS fallbacks). wake_enabled turns on the always-listening wake word so saying 'jarvis' wakes the assistant. Edit this file and restart Jarvis.
name: Jarvis
